key_idea: The tallest person has no arrow going out, because nobody is taller than them.
steps: An arrow goes from the shorter person to the taller one.
P is shorter than Q and S. Q and S are both shorter than R.
R is shorter than T, and no arrow leaves T. So T is the tallest.

choice_feedback.A: P has arrows going to Q and S, so P is shorter than both.
choice_feedback.B: Q has an arrow going to R, so Q is shorter than R.
choice_feedback.C: R has an arrow going to T, so R is shorter than T.
choice_feedback.D: S has an arrow going to R, so S is shorter than R.
